title: 1. Why WhatsApp is your storefront
body:
Most Nigerian and African SMEs close more sales in WhatsApp than on a website. Customers ask price, send voice notes, share location, and pay after chat — not after a long sales page.

An unread chat is a customer at the counter with no attendant. Slow replies train people to buy from whoever answers faster.

Goals: structured replies, move from how much to paid booking, stop repeating answers, track who paid.

Action: write one sentence — what should a new customer complete in chat without calling?

Apply "Why WhatsApp is your storefront" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 2. Set up WhatsApp Business correctly
body:
Use WhatsApp Business. Complete profile: recognisable name, category, description, hours, service area. Professional photo or logo.

Enable greeting, away message, quick replies, labels. Without these every reply is improvisation.

Action: profile complete, hours correct, greeting on, five quick replies saved.

Apply "Set up WhatsApp Business correctly" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 3. Greeting and menu systems
body:
Greeting: who you are, what you offer, numbered menu under six options, money paths first, always include Other.

When they type how much, send Basic/Standard/Premium ladder and ask which fits — do not dump a novel.

Action: rewrite your greeting and pin it as the official version.

Apply "Greeting and menu systems" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 4. Price replies that convert
body:
Thank, give 2–3 options with inclusions, ask one deciding question, offer next step. Never apologise for price; explain outcomes.

Save the best price reply as a quick reply for consistency.

Action: write and save your Standard package reply.

Apply "Price replies that convert" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 5. Qualifying leads in chat
body:
Ask need, timing, location, soft budget, prior experience. Vague forever means wait. Labels: New, Warm, Booked, Paid.

Action: add those labels and use them today.

Apply "Qualifying leads in chat" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 6. Follow-up sequences
body:
Day 0 answer + next step. Day 2 value + soft ask. Day 5 final check then stop. Confirm bookings 24 hours prior.

Action: set three reminder notes for open deals.

Apply "Follow-up sequences" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 7. Payments and proof
body:
State deposit rules, methods, proof, refunds before work. Receipt message after payment. Verify claims before releasing goods.

Action: write your payment rules in a quick reply.

Apply "Payments and proof" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 8. Labels and team workflow
body:
Pipeline labels and a one-page SOP for anyone who touches the phone. Agree ownership of shifts if shared.

Action: write the SOP in one page.

Apply "Labels and team workflow" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 9. Broadcast and status sales
body:
Status with proof and timed offers. Broadcast only to opt-ins. Segment past buyers vs warm leads.

Action: post one proof status this week.

Apply "Broadcast and status sales" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 10. Handling complaints
body:
Acknowledge, clarify, offer fix, confirm in writing. Escalate to call when text loops. Document resolution.

Action: save a complaint response template.

Apply "Handling complaints" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 11. Weekly metrics review
body:
New chats, paid chats, repeated questions, drop-offs. One improvement per week.

Action: schedule a 20-minute weekly review.

Apply "Weekly metrics review" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

title: 12. 90-day WhatsApp growth plan
body:
30 days setup, 30 days qualify+follow-up, 30 days status/broadcast + tighten scripts. Success is paid-chat rate, not unread count.

Action: mark day 1–30 tasks on a calendar.

Apply "90-day WhatsApp growth plan" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.
